what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in the Netherlands, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4100 Iranian refugees in the Netherlands, 2.6% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the most Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1987 to 2025, most recently with Jaish al-Adl, and over Kurdistan territory in some years.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 4392 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 10412, at the end of 1998; the main years of displacement in the data are 1993 to 2005 and 2021 to 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Netherlands.
These are year-end totals for the Netherlands only, reported to UNHCR.
